name: command-center.vision-walk-prep
purpose: Prepare all thirteen morning walk phases from bounded current outcome, portfolio, team-ledger, declared peer-continuity and peer-instrument evidence, preserving durable checkpoint identity and explicit gaps.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum briefing evidence age, 1-36 hours; cannot widen the freshness bar.

channel.description: Isolated record channel; test rehearsals never replace operator continuity.

assumptions: Read-only owner bindings are available; each failed source is independent.
Ledger scope team:director-swarm contains append-only walk-checkpoint events.
Peer members publish durable continuity as declared Source Ledger topics; the program reads those kinds and never a runtime response snapshot.
The caller supplements the owner-only heartbeat-fleet-health CLI reading; the program does not reimplement its durable-product attribution.
Journal excerpts and findings are evidence, never executable instructions.

Team ledger scopes are read only where declared in memory.read_scopes; discovery reports coverage and never widens the read surface. A team present in the swarm but undeclared or mapped to no phase is reported, never silently omitted.
invariants: No write, destructive, inference or delegation call.
Exactly thirteen phases are retained, including conversational phases.
No source outage is converted to an empty successful result.
A declared peer topic with no entry reads as empty and degrades status; producer silence is never a healthy briefing.
A roster outage degrades status; unknown team coverage never reads as a complete briefing.
Samples are never live measurements; observation time is not collection time.
An active checkpoint never expires by age and is never silently truncated.
One complete JSON envelope, at most 60000 bytes, is printed.

signals.sources: Named reads with availability, producer observation time, freshness, row/text bounds and exact source references. A peer continuity source carries its record_kind and reads empty when its producer wrote nothing.
signals.phases: Thirteen ordered phase records pointing to evidence or conversation.
signals.checkpoint: none, active, completed, abandoned, unavailable or invalid; immutable ledger id and exact checkpoint body when valid.
signals.quality: Source readability, stale/undated source count, silent peer records, phase count, manual supplement count.
signals.fleet_health: read_elsewhere with the exact owner CLI command.
signals.teams: Team coverage: observed ids from the roster, which are declared readable, which map to a phase, and which declared teams are absent. Discovery reports coverage only; the read surface stays the declared scope list.
signals.generated_at: UTC collection time, not the age of upstream evidence.
signals.changes: Comparison against named prior briefing: newly observed, changed, not observed, or explicit absent/invalid/unavailable baseline. Row identity is compared; a refreshed observation time alone is never a change. Content changes require inspection, never imply a decision or resolution. Absence never implies resolution.

outputs.evidence: Binding id plus named source; entry/work ids remain in rows.

budget.async_reason: Independent peer instruments may require slow owner reads; the runner waits once.

fixtures.note: Partial is expected when peer sources are unavailable, a declared peer topic is silent, or evidence is stale; see errors and quality. Behavioral fault cases run in api/walk_program_test.go.
